title: Hutchins-Style Ribs

items: ½ cup cracked black pepper (butcher grind)
* Bring to a full boil, simmer for 5 minutes, then rest for 1 hour.

steps: Remove slab from wrapper and place upside down (membrane side down).
If ribs are wet, dab with a paper towel to soak up excess water.
Apply rib rub very liberally on this side of the rib and be sure to cover the entire surface area evenly. Flip over and apply moderately, covering the whole rib.
Apply more rub on the bottom side to allow for some seasoning to come off as it is cooked on the metal rack.
Place into the smoker and set the temp at 225. Cook thoroughly for 5-6 hours with the membrane side up the whole time.
Start checking at 5 hours. The internal temperature should reach 185 degrees. The meat should have a texture and dexterity of a medium-well steak. Not too tough, but not falling off the bone.
Remove from the smoker once the internal temperature is reached.
Let ribs sit for 10-15 minutes in open air.
Apply BBQ sweet glaze moderately to the bottom side (non-membrane side) until there is a nice, glossy look.
